title: Bakiff and Moon Over Cuba credits
summary: Bakiff was with Tempo; he wrote Moon Over Cuba alone, Duke arranging.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: "Baker," "Bakeef," we talked a little bit before, and that was after Mills, so that would've been with Temple. Tempo. Then, "Moon Over Cuba" -- and that one says Tizol and Ellington. That one you wrote alone?
Arranged by Duke. Do you remember anything special about that or how you happened to write it?
